_comment: S10 withholding-tax behavioral fixture. KZ620B reads KZTXIF (gross interest + account type) and writes KZTXRF (national/local/total tax, net). GOLDEN applies per-type treatment (一般 national 15.315% + local 5%; 法人 national 15.315% only, D-1603; NISA exempt = 0, D-1602) and truncates national & local SEPARATELY (D-1604). START applies a flat combined 20.315% to every type with a single combined truncation. The grader recomputes the GOLDEN total tax from this fixture with integer arithmetic (matches COBOL decimal truncation), independent of the golden code. 一般 accounts (A001/A002) isolate the rounding axis (off by 1 yen); 法人 (A003/A004) isolate the per-type rate (start wrongly adds 5% local); NISA (A005/A006) isolate the exemption. To force the per-tax (D-1604) truncation rather than a combined-then-fudge shortcut, A007 (一般, gross 19999) is another exact ¥1 separate-vs-combined divergence while A008 (一般, gross 20000) is a NO-difference control where separate==combined: an agent that fakes separate truncation by subtracting 1 from a combined floor passes A001/A002/A007 but fails A008. START differs on every account except the A008 control (where combined==separate).

accounts.axis: 一般: separate-truncation rounding (combined off by +1)
